sentences.text:
Mcrc No. 6000 of 2023
  Kunjbihari Hathile S/o Bhajram Aged About 42 Years R/o Ward No.17,
 Raipur Bypass Kawardha, District Kabirdham (C.G.)

Present Address
 Government Hr. Sec. School Jaitpuri, Police Station Pipariya, District :
 Kawardha (Kabirdham), Chhattisgarh

---- Applicant
 Versus
  State Of Chhattisgarh Through Police Station Pipariya, District :
 Kawardha (Kabirdham), Chhattisgarh

---- Respondent
For Applicant : Mr. Arvind Shrivastava, Adv.

For Respondent/State : Mr. Shresth Gupta, P.L.
Hon'ble Shri Justice Sanjay Kumar Jaiswal Order on Board 19/09/2023
1.

The accused/applicant has moved this first bail application under Section 439 of Criminal
Procedure Code for releasing him on regular bail during trial in connection with Crime No. 79/2023
registered at Police Station - Pipariaya, District Kabirdham (C.G.) for the offence punishable under
Sections 202, 354, 354-A, 354-B, 376(2)(f) 376(3), 509-B Ipc and Section 4, 8, 10, 12, 16, 17, 21 of
Pocso and Section 67-A of It Act.
2.  There is no appearance on behalf of victim/her family members in- spite of notice being issued.
3. According to the prosecution story, the accused is a teacher of primary school Jaitpuri.

The accused with the help of principal Vijay Janardan (Co-accused) use to do obscene act with the prosecutrix who was studying in the same school and and use to send obscene messages in the mobile of the prosecutrix.
On the basis of the complaint, the accused was arrested on 22.02.2023 for the aforesaid offence.
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the crime in question.

He further submits that the FIR was lodged after one and half month, nothing incriminating has been found in the medical report of the prosecutrix/accused person and he has not committed any offence which has been levelled against him.
He also submits that the applicant is in jail since 22.2.2023, there is no likelihood of his case being decided in near future, therefore, the present appellant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State opposed the bail application.

sentences.text: I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the case diary.

7. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, gravity of offence, and further considering age of the prosecutirx is 12 years, the teacher (accused) has sexually harassed the prosecutrix and six witnesses are examined out of 29 witnesses and also considering the case of the prosecution, at this stage, I am not inclined to release him on bail.
8.
Accordingly, his application filed under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is rejected.
However, the trial Court is directed to expedite the trial and conclude the same as early as possible.
